name: Horizen for WooCommerce
author: horizensh

sections.description:
Horizen for WooCommerce connects your store to Horizen for business analysis and customer communications. A Horizen account and an authorized store connection are required.

Compatible with classic checkout, WooCommerce Checkout Blocks and High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

External Services

After you click Connect Horizen and approve your organization, this plugin creates a dedicated read-only WooCommerce REST API key owned by your existing WordPress administrator account and sends it over HTTPS to Horizen to configure analytics. No additional WordPress user is created. Pending credentials are encrypted locally for retry and removed after acknowledgement. Disconnect revokes plugin-owned keys and pauses analytics without deleting historical data. Deactivation retains analytics access; uninstall revokes the key before requesting remote disconnection.

This plugin connects to the Horizen service at https://app.horizen.sh. An authorized WooCommerce administrator must approve the connection.

Connection requests exchange the store address and the information needed to establish and manage access. After connection, the plugin collects and sends shopping activity, product and cart details, checkout and signed-in customer email addresses, order identifiers and status, communication preferences and supported shopping-session restoration activity. Checkout information may be collected before a purchase is completed. The plugin does not collect payment card numbers or card security codes.

Activity data is delivered in the background. Connection management and shopping-session restoration also make direct service requests. The data supports business analysis and customer communications, including email and marketing where enabled. Store owners must disclose relevant processing and obtain consent where required.

Privacy policy: https://horizen.sh/privacy-policy/
Service information: https://horizen.sh/
For service terms or privacy requests, contact luka@horizen.sh.

Privacy

Temporary local activity data is encrypted. Successfully transferred records are eligible for cleanup 7 days after delivery; permanently failed records after 30 days; shopping-session records 30 days after the last activity; and completed restoration records after 30 days. Unfinished processing may be retained until resolved, and cleanup depends on the store’s scheduled tasks running.

WordPress personal data export and erasure tools cover supported local plugin records. Hosted data and backups have separate retention arrangements described in the privacy policy. To request secure deletion of hosted data, email luka@horizen.sh. Removing local records does not erase all copies held by the service or ordinary WooCommerce records.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce 7.9 or newer.
  2. In WordPress, open Plugins > Add New and search for “Horizen for WooCommerce”.
  3. Select Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open WooCommerce > Horizen and select Connect Horizen.
  5. Approve the connection using your Horizen account and return to Horizen onboarding while verification finishes.

Updates are available through the standard WordPress plugin update screen.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Horizen account?

Yes. The store must be connected to the appropriate Horizen organization before connected data collection begins.

Does entering an email address provide marketing consent?

No. Email collection does not by itself record consent. Merchants are responsible for an appropriate legal basis, notices and any necessary consent controls. Enabled communications follow the merchant’s settings and applicable opt-out preferences.

Does it support Checkout Blocks and HPOS?

Yes. Both are supported alongside classic WooCommerce checkout.

Does it support WordPress Multisite?

No. This version does not support WordPress Multisite and stops its own activation on multisite networks.

What happens to complex carts?

Products, variations and quantities are restored using current store validation and prices. Coupons and loyalty discounts may need to be entered again. Items with unsupported required options or bundle configuration are listed with links so the shopper can select those options again. A failed restoration preserves the current cart.

Does it capture every email field on a page?

No. Capture is limited to recognized checkout fields. Newsletter and contact forms are excluded. Custom checkout integrations can register a scoped adapter. A visitor who has not signed in or provided an email address cannot receive an email reminder.

How do I disconnect the store?

Use Disconnect on the plugin’s settings page. Disconnecting stops the connected integration and removes local connection data; it does not erase copies already held by Horizen. Contact Horizen to request deletion of hosted data.
sections.changelog:
0.2.1

  • Preserve local encrypted connection and event data when the site is accessed through a different domain.
  • Add authenticated operator recovery for previously unreadable connections, without replacing installation credentials.

0.2.0

  • Connect store analytics automatically with a read-only API key owned by your existing administrator.
  • Upgrade existing store connections while retaining connector identity and historical data.
  • Revoke plugin-owned keys and pause analytics on disconnect; temporary deactivation keeps analytics running.

0.1.9

  • More reliable background delivery during and after service or network outages.
  • Cart recovery links now recover automatically after temporary store issues.
  • Reduced storefront overhead: fewer duplicate capture operations and no background request on pages without a cart or checkout.
  • Improved WooCommerce Checkout Blocks compatibility across supported versions.
  • More complete cleanup when the plugin is uninstalled.

0.1.8

  • Improved compatibility with WooCommerce stores.
  • Improved overall stability and reliability.
  • General usability improvements.

  • General stability and reliability improvements.
